attributes.powers:
The difficulty to defeat is increased by twice the scenario's adventure deck number.

If undefeated, shuffle this card into a random open location deck and discard a card.

If defeated, shuffle this card into a random other open location deck, and you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.
